_doc: workers: true lets the lead start workers (bin/lead worker, bin/wt; the owner's yes first, then setup sets it). worker: what a worker of the role is: kind write (its own worktree of repo, on its own branch), read (a read-only checkout of repo), board (no repo: reads the machine, writes only the board as <role>/<name>). repo: {home}/{mm}/{root}-relative or absolute; never the brain. Its permissions: leads/<role>/.claude/worker.tmpl.json, rendered by config-check.

roles.title: Ops & SRE
roles.summary: Runs the machine through the brain's run loop; watches it and handles incidents.

roles.title: Security & compliance review
roles.summary: Reviews every T2 plan, the posture and the audit trail; never applies changes.

roles.title: Platform (mm)
roles.summary: Owns mm and its template; rolls updates out; governs projects through their boards.
